data.text: **Async/await** enables asynchronous programming, allowing your code to perform non-blocking operations.

data.title: async/await
Task
Avoid async void
data.text: Use async Task instead of async void except for event handlers. async void can't be awaited and errors are hard to catch.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Async/await is essential for responsive apps.
